mapper.insert: insert into hr_attendance_result(user_id, dept_id, work_date, shift_id, expected_in_time, expected_out_time, actual_in_time, actual_out_time, late_flag, early_flag, miss_card_flag, absent_flag, expected_minutes, actual_minutes, create_by, create_time) values(#{userId}, (select dept_id from hr_schedule where user_id = #{userId} and work_date = #{workDate} limit 1), #{workDate}, (select shift_id from hr_schedule where user_id = #{userId} and work_date = #{workDate} limit 1), #{expectedInTime}, #{expectedOutTime}, #{actualInTime}, #{actualOutTime}, #{lateFlag}, #{earlyFlag}, #{missCardFlag}, #{absentFlag}, #{expectedMinutes}, #{actualMinutes}, #{createBy}, sysdate())

insert into hr_attendance_exception(user_id, work_date, exception_type, exception_detail, create_by, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{workDate}, #{exceptionType}, #{exceptionDetail}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select d.dept_name, count(1) as totalDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(r.actual_minutes) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{arg0} and r.dept_id = #{arg1} and r.user_id = #{arg2} group by r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by r.dept_id

select u.user_name, d.dept_name, count(1) as totalDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(r.actual_minutes) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{arg0} and r.dept_id = #{arg1} and r.user_id = #{arg2} group by r.user_id, u.user_name, d.dept_name order by r.user_id
